<function name="SetTextHidden" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Makes <page>TextEntry</page>'s text be replaced by `*` characters, just like a password-entry text field would.
	</description>
	<added>2025.09.22</added>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="" type="boolean">Whether to have the text be hidden.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
